name: What kind of warranty or guarantee do you offer on your painting services?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty or guarantee do you offer on your painting services?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stand behind the quality of our workmanship. Our painting services typically come with a warranty covering issues related to paint adhesion and application, provided proper surface preparation was possible and the paint was applied according to manufacturer specifications. Specific warranty details are outlined in our project contract, ensuring peace of mind for our clients in Berkeley, Oakland, and surrounding areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: We offer a warranty on our painting services covering paint adhesion and application issues, detailed in our project contract.
